# jbig2dec 0.20 (subset)

These files are a subset of [jbig2dec](https://github.com/ArtifexSoftware/jbig2dec)
version 0.20, vendored so CAJ/HN JBIG2 images can be decoded on Windows, macOS,
and Linux without a system `libjbig2dec` package.

Only the decoder library sources are included (not the `jbig2dec` CLI, PNG/PBM
I/O helpers, tests, or autotools files).

- Upstream: https://github.com/ArtifexSoftware/jbig2dec
